Name: Product Accuracy Data (Absolute)
Description: This TRE contains the DPPDB absolute product accuracy data. All accuracy data is based on 90% confidence (CE, LE, and mensuration).

PACE.Name: DPPDB Absolute CE90
PACE.Description: This field indicates the DPPDB absolute accuracy (CE90).

PALE.Name: DPPDB Absolute LE90
PALE.Description: This field indicates the DPPDB absolute accuracy (LE90).

PSDCE.Name: DPPDB Support Data CE90
PSDCE.Description: This field indicates the DPPDB support data CE90.

PSDLE.Name: DPPDB Support Data LE90
PSDLE.Description: This field indicates the DPPDB support data LE90.

PMCE.Name: DPPDB Mensuration CE
PMCE.Description: This field indicates the DPPDB mensuration accuracy (1 pixel) CE90.

PMLE.Name: DPPDB Mensuration LE
PMLE.Description: This field indicates the DPPDB mensuration accuracy (1 pixel) LE90.
